scope.split: dev only (from split_manifest.json assignments where split=dev)

probe_schedule.interval_method: strict position downsampling from the interval-64 bank: keep probes at positions p with (p - start_token) % interval == 0
probe_schedule.convention_record: start=64 for all intervals; dense_probe.py default start_token=64, interval=64

caps.method: REAL capped generation: each cap is an independent completions call with max_tokens=cap, stop=['\]'], temperature/top_p/seed identical to dense_simple32. NO character slicing, NO truncation of a cap-32 answer.
caps.prompt_semantics: apply_chat_template(problem) + decode(token_ids[:position]) + SIMPLE_SUFFIX ('**Final Answer**\n\n\\[ \\boxed{'), identical to dense_probe.py so cap-32 is comparable to the authoritative dense bank
caps.cap_enforcement: checked with the model's own tokenizer: actual completion_tokens <= cap; re-encoded count stored alongside

cost_accounting.probe_prompt_tokens: reported separately (sensitivity view adds them: actual + probe_prompt)

aggregation.bootstrap: paired hierarchical resampling over seeds+problems, 10000 samples, seed 20260727 (reuses related_work.metrics shape)
